name: bizplug-food-delivery
description: The food delivery plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: delivery orders. It works from the business's own published profile, covering delivery zones, minimums and order help, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.
